##### Project general facts

Vela Viento by Omniyat is a landmark residential development that redefines contemporary luxury living in Dubai. Designed by the globally renowned Foster + Partners, the tower is characterized by fluid horizontal lines and elegant curves that create a dynamic architectural rhythm. Interiors are crafted by the Parisian design studio Gilles & Boissier, bringing a refined balance of modern sophistication and timeless elegance. The project features an exclusive collection of two- to four-bedroom residences and signature penthouses, many with double-height spaces and private terrace pools, emphasizing seamless indoor-outdoor living.

A defining feature of the project is its elevated lifestyle offering, centered around the Sky Amenities Deck. Positioned high above the city, this space includes an infinity pool, double-height gym, yoga studio, and elegant lounge areas, all overlooking panoramic views of Marasi Bay, Burj Khalifa, and Downtown Dubai. These amenities are designed to enhance wellbeing and create a tranquil, resort-like environment where residents can relax, recharge, and connect.

The residences are defined by generous proportions and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize light, space, and views. Unique architectural elements, such as suspended “hanging” dining rooms, create a distinctive living experience that blends interior spaces with the surrounding skyline. Fully furnished interiors, equipped kitchens, and carefully selected materials reflect a harmonious fusion of contemporary and classical design, resulting in homes that are both elegant and enduring.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
